accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot

hypercore_slot_active_after_action.meaning: HyperCore has the 0x811 supplied-balance slot active after the accepted action
hypercore_slot_active_after_action.checkpoint: after the accepted action, before later reads

registration_pending.meaning: the BLP supplied-slot registration remains pending rather than promoted

supplied_balance_read_succeeded.meaning: a suppliedBalance read for the 0x811 slot succeeded

total_backing_signed_reverted.checkpoint: after supplyToBlp, before removeSuppliedEntry clears the entry

assumptions: The accepted action and the later totalBackingSigned() call occur in the same scenario described by the report.
removeSuppliedEntry has not yet cleared the pending entry at the time of the later reads.

unresolved.description: The report does not specify the exact trigger or timing by which a pending registration is promoted after a successful suppliedBalance read, so the promotion event is represented only by the pending/read-succeeded observables.
The impact lists three reverting functions (totalBackingSigned, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL) as one outcome; only totalBackingSigned is bound as the observable revert witness.

limitations: The inactive-slot outcome is potential/conditional in the report; the condition encodes the scenario where HyperCore leaves the slot inactive rather than asserting it as observed.
The intent's asynchronous-activation qualifier is captured only through the pending-registration and successful-read observables; the precise promotion mechanism is not specified by the report.
